shortDescription: Lightweight, waterproof, flame-retardant PVC marble panels — the ideal alternative to natural marble for walls and interiors.
description: PVC Marble Sheet is an eco-friendly decorative panel primarily made of PVC resin with a high-precision marble pattern formed through UV surface treatment. It features lightweight, waterproof, moisture-resistant, flame-retardant properties, and quick installation, making it widely used for interior wall decoration such as bathrooms, kitchens, and background walls — as an ideal alternative to natural marble.

features.description: Completely moisture-proof and waterproof — ideal for bathroom walls and kitchen backsplashes.

features.description: Excellent flexibility — performs perfectly even on walls with slight curvature.

installationSteps: Compact the wall surface (putty powder / cement mortar / wooden boards) and measure flatness to ensure it is within ±3mm.
Apply neutral structural adhesive to the back of the wall panel with evenly distributed dots along the edge — one dot every 10cm, approximately 200ml per square metre.
Use metal strips to connect and install the wall panels.
For corners: ensure wall flatness within ±2mm, ensure the wall is clean and dust-free, then install using structural adhesive. Metal accessories can be used as connectors.

shortDescription: Real wood texture PVC film over a WPC core — combining natural warmth, zero formaldehyde, and effortless installation.
description: WPC Wall Panels use PVC and calcium powder as main raw materials, carefully mixed in a specific proportion and extruded in a high-temperature environment. After cooling, they are covered with a PVC film with a real wood texture, creating a wall decoration material that is both beautiful and practical. Anti-corrosion, eco-friendly, and easy to install with a simple notch-joint system.

features.title: Anti-Corrosion & Anti-Insect
features.description: High strength and good toughness — does not rot, deform, or succumb to termites.

features.title: ECO Friendly
features.description: Recyclable material with almost zero formaldehyde release — healthier for your family.

features.title: Easy Installation
features.description: Lap joint system with notch joints — no complicated tools or specialized skills required.

features.title: Moisture-Proof
features.description: Low water absorption with strong adaptability to humid environments.

accessories.name: 25×25mm Corner Trim
accessories.description: Matching colour trim for clean corners

installationSteps: Level the wall surface (drywall compound / cement mortar / wood panel) and measure wall flatness to ensure it is within ±3mm.
Apply neutral structural adhesive to the back of the wall panel — glue dots evenly distributed along panel edges, one dot every 10cm, approximately 200ml per square metre.
Secure the wall panels using metal strips for a secure, professional finish.

shortDescription: Co-extruded wood-plastic composite panels that won't rot, fade, or require maintenance — built to outlast the elements.
description: WPC Outdoor Panels are engineered for exterior applications where durability and aesthetics must coexist. The surface of co-extruded plastic wood is rich in colours, with a natural smooth wooden feel that is durable and does not fade. The all-inclusive and semi-inclusive profile systems allow flexibility across a wide range of facade, fencing, and pergola applications.

shortDescription: Lightweight, thermally insulating, and sound-absorbing polystyrene panels in multiple architectural profiles for interior applications.
description: PS wallboard is a new type of architectural decorative panel made primarily from polystyrene resin through extrusion or moulding processes. It is an ideal wall material in modern architecture — possessing lightweight and high strength, thermal insulation, sound insulation and noise reduction, waterproofing and moisture resistance. Its comprehensive performance far exceeds that of traditional panels.
size: Multiple profiles — widths from 130mm to 310mm, all at 2900mm length

shortDescription: Slatted MDF acoustic panels that combine stunning wood aesthetics with scientifically engineered sound absorption for any interior.
description: MDF Acoustic panels are ideal sound-absorbing decorative materials. Their sound-absorption principle is achieved through acoustic impedance matching and multiple reflections, refractions, and attenuations of sound waves. They offer advantages including sound absorption, environmental friendliness, fire-retardancy, thermal insulation, heat preservation, moisture resistance, mold prevention, easy cleaning, easy cutting, patterned tiling, simple installation, good stability, impact resistance, and cost-effectiveness.
